requirement: bml-inference-pipeline 8.6 (persisted symbolic AOT and CLI implemented; real-model scalability/range and legacy scalar route remain open)

implementation.compiler: Operation construction resides in bml-compiler::symbolic_kernels and has node, total/per-output opcode, scalar-program and fragment budgets.
implementation.aot: The exact canonical operation plan covers all causal prefixes up to the declared token count. All programs are built before manifest publication.
implementation.bindings: The complete GGUF hash, source configuration, KV heads, RMS epsilon, RoPE base and tokenizer are checked. Fixed scalar literals must match the profile signature; model weights are not stored in the program files.
implementation.loader: Stored hashes and bytecode are read under byte/count budgets, with no bytecode regeneration. Runtime preflight validates references, stack and execution limits before exposing the model. Missing kernels cannot trigger compilation in AOT mode.
implementation.cli: compile --symbolic requires --context-size; run detects the profile and supports hash-checked --weights relocation. Requested generation capacity is clamped to compiled context. Mixed native/symbolic markers are rejected.

verification.aot_fixture: One-layer GQA/RoPE/nonzero MLP fixture previously checked against the independent C64 oracle; AOT and lazy logits are bit-identical for tested prefill/decode. AOT uses 256-byte fragment targets.
verification.no_regeneration: AOT loads and executes with max_nodes=0. Replacing the persisted residual-add program with One (and its hash) yields the independent predicted head logits 0.25/sqrt(1.5).
verification.io_fixture: Actual compile/run processes generate the byte pair for é, then EOS, with a moved GGUF source and context boundaries. The existing native compiled CLI test also passes.
rejections: source hash, configuration, tokenizer and profile mismatches
incomplete operation plans, changed widths and fixed literals
corrupt/truncated or oversized files, native opcodes, invalid references and stack effects
nonempty output directories and absent explicit CLI compile context

limitations: AOT persistence does not fix the BML expansions numerical range or rounding limitations.
No real downloaded model is certified under this symbolic profile; tiny fixtures are not large-model validation.
Scalar-output duplication and unrolled row programs still limit storage and compile/runtime scalability.
The historical scalar build_transformer_dag remains outside this working AOT path and is still pending.
This change integrates the CLI; the HTTP server currently supports the earlier native causal artifact profile.
Row decoding/conversion still allocates scratch memory; the claim is external source weights and no serialized learned weights.
